defect_observations.observation: Source scope. The worked range estimate and its omitted-variable failure are built on Mahajan Sec. 1.2 (printed pp. 6-7). The component's required extent names chapter 1 Secs. 1.3-1.5 only for the finite estimate example. The in-extent estimates at dimensional-and-scaling-inference.tex 566-615 (bill volume, train-line range, oil, barrel cross-check) are reconstructed, but none is carried to an order-of-magnitude report with an omitted-variable failure; the train-line range (574-588) points to the Sec. 1.2 lane case. The success condition does not name a section, so this is recorded rather than failed.

Notation conflict across the route. The flight-range order estimate is written d ~ beta E_fuel/(sqrt(C) g) in the source's 'comparable to' sense. def:p15-approximation-relations (approximate-quantitative-inference.tex 22-23, 51-54) reserves ~ for ratio limits, and p15-073 272-282 uses that sense. The dimensional chapter declares only the proportional sign (185-186) and never says which meaning ~ has there.

Digits beyond the inputs elsewhere in the unit's treatment. Line 433 gives the flight range as 'about 9.8x10^6 m' right after saying the estimate discards a factor of order two; the source reports roughly 10^4 km (printed p. 132). Line 326 gives T sqrt(g/l) as 6.201 from l of about 0.65 m; the source gives 6.20 (printed p. 149). Neither is the C04 worked estimate, but both conflict with the reporting convention def:p15-w02b-p15-073-reporting.

The upper endpoint 5400/(1+4/35)=4846.15... appears inside an inequality as 'q <= approx. 4846', which rounds a bound inward against the chapter's outward-rounding convention (81-90). The rounded report of 5x10^3 is unaffected.

The step from the products qtau and z, with n 'as a parameter', to qtau/n=Phi(z) uses an unstated premise: q is n times a car flow that does not depend on n (lane-model definition, 96-98). Dimensions alone give qtau=Psi(z; n). The C02 exponent-relation derivation also stands independently at dimensional-and-scaling-inference.tex 104-110, 301-322 and 500-521.
